<thought>Based on the limited data (C7H14O5, one carbonyl, one CH₃, and multiple oxygenated groups) the molecule can be considered as being built from a carbonyl fragment and two oxygen‑containing carbon fragments that can be joined together. The simplest representation of these connected fragments in SMILES form is a carbonyl ester fragment and two alkyl‑oxygen fragments.</thought>
<final_answer>['C(=O)O', 'CO', 'CC']</final_answer>
